name: Bronze Valley VentureLab
evidence: Umbrella accelerator (Bronze Valley VentureLab, Wilmington DE) consolidating the Bronze Valley Investment Accelerator (equity) + gBETA Bronze Valley (free pre-accelerator) cohorts under one Dealroom entity, with gener8tor as OPERATING PARTNER. Its own /investors/bronze_valley_venturelab profile (in scope, like NMotion) — supersedes the Bronze Valley FUND entity (bronze_valley, pf 42) and un-excludes gBETA. Worked 2026-09-11: 17 companies moved under the umbrella (7 created + 10 existing linked, incl. 4 existing adds not on the reviewed sheet). gener8tor's GLOBAL entity (1427) stays untracked.

name: The Innovation Space - Science Inc. Accelerator
evidence: 14-week virtual accelerator for early-stage science startups. Fall cohorts for life sciences, spring cohorts for cleantech and advanced materials. Running since 2020, 88 startups supported to date.

name: CAFE Fintech Accelerator (Center for Accelerating Financial Equity)
evidence: Cohort-based fintech accelerator at UD's FinTech Innovation Hub. 6 growth-ready fintech companies per cohort, 2-month hybrid program. Equity-free. Spring and Fall cohorts.

name: Horn Entrepreneurship Summer Founders
evidence: University of Delaware pre-accelerator for students and recent alumni. 10-week intensive program with funding, resources, and mentorship. 10th cohort in 2025 with 19 teams.

name: Business on Main Street Accelerator
evidence: 8-week cohort program by Delaware Division of Small Business and Launcher. 6 virtual sessions + 2 in-person in Dover. First cohort started September 2026.
